prompts.prompt: Create a production game-asset sprite sheet for an original cozy island survival card game. Square canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal-sized invisible cells. Sixteen individual isolated objects, each fully inside its own cell, centered, equal visual size, generous transparent padding, no overlaps, no printed grid. Transparent background. Style: charming hand-painted cut-paper fantasy inventory illustrations, chunky simplified sculptural silhouettes, bold smooth very dark petrol-teal outlines (#173D46), cream highlights (#FFE9BE), muted jade and dusty turquoise planes, warm coral-orange (#EF866E) accents, a little flat gouache grain, 2-3 big clean color planes with restrained highlights, consistent 3/4 orthographic view. Readable at a small card thumbnail. Original objects only; no characters, no cards, no frames, no UI, no labels, no letters, no numerals, no cast-shadow backdrop. Follow this exact row-major order (top-left to bottom-right): Row1: 1 a chunky irregular gray shoreline stone; 2 two short driftwood logs tied with fiber; 3 a loose hank of pale plant fibers; 4 a sharp blue-gray flint shard. Row2: 5 one small pale scalloped shell; 6 one large cream ridged shell; 7 a closed conical limpet shell with a small dark foot beneath; 8 one uncooked coral-beige shelled-mollusk flesh with a small cream lip. Row3: 9 one thick cut aloe leaf with green rind and pale juicy face; 10 a small open shell-cup holding translucent aloe gel; 11 a neat cream rolled medical bandage; 12 a rough folded fiber dressing tied with twine. Row4: 13 a dark teal seaweed tuft with rounded curling fronds; 14 an organic scraps pile made of vegetable peels and brown leaves; 15 a low soft pile of pale gray ash; 16 several jagged dull gray scrap chips. Clear distinctions between all 16 objects. Every icon must remain separated by transparent gutters; do not add any other objects.

Keep raw and cooked foods clearly different, seed tuber different from food tuber, and all 3 knives unmistakably different.

Exact row-major order: top-left 1 WOUND: a simplified isolated cream-colored palm with one clear small diagonal coral scratch on its center and a tiny folded cloth beside it; top-middle 2 BLEEDING: three prominent glossy coral-red blood droplets, one large and two small, with a small cream cloth under the largest, clean stylized and non-gory; top-right 3 LOCAL INFECTION: a simplified cream palm with a warm reddish sore patch surrounded by several tiny dusty-green germ-like specks and one muted green haze, no open gore. Bottom-left 4 PAIN: a simplified clenched cream hand surrounded by three sharp coral zigzag pain bursts, strong readable silhouette; bottom-middle 5 ENVIRONMENTAL IRRITATION: a cream hand with a red itchy spot and surrounding gray-green dusty contact cloud plus small specks, visibly different from infection; bottom-right 6 HUNGER WEAKNESS: a small EMPTY cream food bowl and drooping leaf beside a slumped simplified headless torso-shaped cream silhouette, use a muted desaturated coral weak core to communicate lack of food, no face. Unified dark teal contour and warm cream/coral/jade palette matching the reference atlas. Transparent spacing separates all six completely.
